notes: Closes the m = 2 cell of the magic-cat family at chi(|cat_2>) = 1 on both sides alongside bounds/cat-m2-upper-1.json (verified), as in Qassim, Pashayan, and Gosset (arXiv:2106.07740, Table 1). verify_challenge/cert_cat_m2_rank1.py checks symbolically against stabrank_verify.target_vector('cat', 2) that all 2 x 2 projective minors with |00> + i|11> vanish and |||cat_2>||^2 = 1 > 0, so the empty sum of zero stabilizer states cannot represent |cat_2>.
